name: Youtu-Parsing-Omni

lineage.base_model: Youtu-LLM decoder with a Youtu-Omni-Encoder initialised from a text language model
lineage.how_derived: omni-modal parsing model; successor of Youtu-Parsing (2.5B)

purpose: One compact model that parses documents, natural images, charts and flowcharts, geometry, audio and audio-visual video into one structured JSON envelope covering perception (layout, text, tables, formulas, boxes, ASR, timestamps) and cognition (captions, narratives, reports).

license.name: Youtu-Parsing License (Apache-2.0-style with a territorial exclusion)
license.notes: LICENSE text read. Clause 0: "Youtu-Parsing IS NOT INTENDED FOR USE WITHIN THE EUROPEAN UNION", and the clause prevails in a conflict. Sections 2-4 grant copyright and patent licenses and redistribution as in Apache-2.0. The exclusion makes it unusable for EU users and for a project that distributes in the EU.

architecture.kind: omni-modal single-tower encoder plus Youtu-LLM decoder emitting OmniSchema JSON
architecture.why_this_design: Card: the usual separate vision and audio towers are replaced by one Youtu-Omni-Encoder, initialised from a pre-trained text language model to strengthen text reading; modalities meet inside the language model.

pc-12gb.notes: 10.7 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 10.7 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 10.7 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 10.7 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: custom architecture youtu_vita; no GGUF seen.

benchmarks.name: OmniParsingBench average
benchmarks.variant: best open-weight model per the card, second to Gemini-3-Pro

strengths: one model for documents, charts, chemistry structures, music scores, audio, video

tona_fit.reason: Quality is top-tier (vendor 96.96 OmniDocBench v1.6) but clause 0 of the license excludes use within the European Union; Tona cannot offer it to its users there.

open_questions: independent confirmation of the OmniDocBench number
